site.purpose: Help privacy-seeking consumers choose a VPN subscription plan and obtain an activated IPVanish account.

baseline.timezone_policy: temporary deterministic default; re-freeze from capture evidence

roles.notes: Every surface in frozen scope is reachable anonymously: marketing tree, pricing with its three billing-period tabs, the checkout funnel's payment-method chooser and registration form, the SSO sign-in and password-recovery views, and the support centre.

IPVanish has no free tier, no web free trial and no account-only signup: 'Sign up now!' on the sign-in page links to /pricing/, and account credentials are created inside the purchase funnel. my.ipvanish.com redirects anonymous visitors to sso.ipvanish.com with TOKEN_EXPIRED. Obtaining this role requires a real payment, which is prohibited and which the user declined. All subscriber surfaces are recorded unavailable; the clone implements them locally and discloses them as inference.

core_journeys.purpose: Compare monthly and annual plans, select the annual plan, and fill in the account registration form
core_journeys.steps: entry -> /pricing/ -> activate the Monthly Plan tab and read its prices -> activate the Yearly Plan tab and read its prices -> choose a Yearly tier's Get Essential/Get Advanced CTA -> checkout/address-payment-method?flow=essential-annual -> activate the Credit card row -> the registration form (account email + billing/card fields) renders with the order summary and auto-renewal disclosure
core_journeys.expected_result: the registration form is reachable and filled, with the order summary showing the annual plan's price, discount, estimated tax and total due
core_journeys.failure_variant: required-field validation when the form is submitted incomplete
core_journeys.recovery_variant: returning to the payment-method chooser or back to pricing preserves the chosen plan
core_journeys.note: On the source, submitting this form would create a real subscription and charge a real card, so capture stops at the filled/rendered form. On the clone the same journey completes through a local-sandbox scenario selector instead of card fields.

core_journeys.purpose: Browse the subscription offerings and compare available plans and tiers
core_journeys.steps: read the three billing-period tabs (2-Year default / Yearly / Monthly), the Essential and Advanced tiers, their per-month prices, struck-through retail totals, promo and renewal copy, and the feature comparison table; expand 'View All Features'
core_journeys.expected_result: prices and feature rows change with the active period; Advanced carries the 'Best Protection' ribbon

core_journeys.purpose: Select a plan tier and the relevant product options
core_journeys.steps: choose Essential or Advanced within a billing period; follow the CTA into the checkout flow whose flow parameter encodes tier and period; choose a payment method; observe the auto-renew disclosure
core_journeys.expected_result: the checkout order summary reflects exactly the chosen tier and period
core_journeys.recovery_variant: changing plan means returning to pricing (the flow param is the only selector)
core_journeys.note: Quantity and delivery frequency (from the trace text) do not exist on this source: a VPN subscription has no quantity selector and no delivery cadence. Recorded as a trace-vs-source divergence.

core_journeys.purpose: Open the sign-in entry and verify the identity field and available credential choices without submitting
core_journeys.steps: observe 'Welcome back! Sign in to continue to customer portal', the Email address and Password fields, 'Forgot password?', and 'Not a member? Sign up now!' which links to /pricing/
core_journeys.expected_result: fields and links are visible; no credentials submitted
core_journeys.note: No third-party identity-provider buttons were observed in the SSO page source (only fonts and GTM), so social sign-in appears absent — recorded rather than assumed.

core_journeys.purpose: Open password recovery and verify the reset-address field and return link without sending a reset message
core_journeys.steps: click 'Forgot password?' -> /reset-password/ -> observe 'Reset password', 'Enter you account email, you will receive a reset password code', the Email address field (input name 'username'), 'Back to sign in' and 'Send code'
core_journeys.expected_result: recovery view renders with its field and return link; nothing sent
core_journeys.failure_variant: validation on an empty or malformed address
core_journeys.recovery_variant: 'Back to sign in' returns to the sign-in view
core_journeys.note: Reachable only by clicking through; the un-slashed /reset-password deep link returns 403 from its S3 origin. The 'Enter you account email' typo is source copy and is reproduced verbatim.

core_journeys.purpose: Reach public help, support and contact guidance without exposing private account data
core_journeys.steps: open the support centre, its categories and the FAQ; note the on-site pricing FAQ and the ticket entry
core_journeys.note: The support centre is a Zendesk Guide on a subdomain; its internal taxonomy renders only with an ordinary browser UA.

core_journeys.purpose: Use the primary navigation from the public entry to reach the subscription surface and verify the destination heading and canonical path
core_journeys.steps: open each primary-nav dropdown (Product, Features, Solutions, Apps, Resources) and follow Pricing to /pricing/; verify the 'IPVanish plans & pricing' heading and the canonical path
core_journeys.expected_result: destination heading and canonical path visible

core_journeys.purpose: Verify a no-results state and a not-found recovery route
core_journeys.steps: search the support centre for 'zzzz-no-match-websitebench' and read its empty state; open a non-existent deep link and read the not-found view
core_journeys.expected_result: graceful recovery routes back to available plans and support
core_journeys.note: The marketing site has no product search; discovery is browse-only, so the no-results trace is answered by the support centre's search and by an impossible pricing/locale filter. Frozen from capture evidence.

core_journeys.purpose: Open a subscription action with required fields empty or while signed out and verify validation or a permission prompt
core_journeys.steps: submit the sign-in and recovery forms empty; open my.ipvanish.com signed out and observe the redirect to SSO
core_journeys.expected_result: inline validation or a permission redirect identifies what must be corrected

core_journeys.purpose: Open the account dashboard and manage the subscription: review orders and billing history, change plan, pause or cancel and reactivate, and edit the billing contact
core_journeys.steps: sign in; open the dashboard and its VPN/antivirus/cloud-storage/reports areas; review billing history; change plan; pause; cancel; reactivate
core_journeys.expected_result: subscription state changes are reflected in the dashboard
core_journeys.note: UNAVAILABLE on the source: reaching this role requires a real purchase, which is prohibited. Route names were observed from the my.ipvanish.com build manifest (/, /vpn, /antivirus, /cloud-storage, /secure_browser, /proxy, /wireguard, /reports, /refer-and-earn, /ideas-portal) but no rendered subscriber state was ever seen. The clone implements a local dashboard and discloses every part of it as inference.
